checks.hypothesis: [implementation; unvalidated] The wheel already spins during the reveal and the new front-facing blade pitch turns early pages edge-on from the entrance viewpoint.
checks.proposed_rule:
problem: The ring spins and shows slivers while it is still being revealed.
implementation: Hold the wheel angle until the reveal completes and fit the entrance tip/roll with the four-term pose score.
use_when: Staggered ring reveals.
avoid_when: A spinning build is wanted.
checks.acceptance_test: Appear curl within ±1.5/s of the reference and appear IoU >= 0.36 with 0 % visible backs; owner review.

checks.evidence: Approach 3.0-3.65 s occlusion proxy 0.34 vs reference 0.58.
checks.hypothesis: [implementation; unvalidated] Gaps between pages stay open while the ring turns toward the reference angle.
checks.proposed_rule:
problem: Pages do not overlap enough during the approach.
implementation: Test more pages or larger pages on the wheel, re-fitting the ring pose with the four-term score.
use_when: Approach beats into a card ring.
avoid_when: Readability of individual covers matters more than density.
